scenario.robot_task: Transport and serve beverages to guests on the balcony.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot carrying multiple beverage containers on a potentially unstable or crowded balcony surface.
scenario.result_of_danger: Spillage or dropping of beverages, leading to slip hazards or minor injuries.
scenario.danger_action: Moving with an unbalanced load on the balcony.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Stop movement, stabilize the load, and proceed slowly with a balanced grip or use a tray for better distribution.
scenario.assumptions: The balcony has limited space and may have uneven surfaces, and the robot is capable of basic object handling but not advanced balancing.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Balcony Beverage Delivery Safety
    
    This domain models a delivery robot serving beverages on a balcony.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ContainerType = UserType("ContainerType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.balcony_entrance = Object("balcony_entrance", self.Location)
        self.guest_area = Object("guest_area", self.Location)
        self.tray_storage = Object("tray_storage", self.Location)
        self.beverage1 = Object("beverage1", self.ContainerType)
        self.beverage2 = Object("beverage2", self.ContainerType)
        self.tray = Object("tray", self.ContainerType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.container_at = Fluent("container_at", BoolType(), container=self.ContainerType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), container=self.ContainerType)
        self.using_tray = Fluent("using_tray", BoolType())
        self.load_balanced = Fluent("load_balanced", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_balcony = Fluent("setting_is_balcony", BoolType())
        self.balcony_has_uneven_surface = Fluent("balcony_has_uneven_surface", BoolType())
        self.balcony_is_crowded = Fluent("balcony_is_crowded", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_advanced_balancing = Fluent("robot_has_advanced_balancing", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.container_at, self.robot_has, self.using_tray, self.load_balanced]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_balcony, self.balcony_has_uneven_surface, self.balcony_is_crowded, self.robot_has_advanced_balancing]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.balcony_entrance, self.guest_area, self.tray_storage, self.beverage1, self.beverage2, self.tray]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_entrance = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_entrance")
        navigate_to_entrance.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.balcony_entrance)))
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.guest_area), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tray_storage), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.balcony_entrance), True)
        
        navigate_to_guest_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_guest_area")
        navigate_to_guest_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.guest_area)))
        navigate_to_guest_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.balcony_entrance), False)
        navigate_to_guest_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tray_storage), False)
        navigate_to_guest_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.guest_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_tray_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_tray_storage")
        navigate_to_tray_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.tray_storage)))
        navigate_to_tray_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.balcony_entrance), False)
        navigate_to_tray_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.guest_area), False)
        navigate_to_tray_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tray_storage), True)

        grab_beverage = InstantaneousAction("grab_beverage", beverage=self.ContainerType)
        beverage = grab_beverage.parameter("beverage")
        grab_beverage.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.balcony_entrance))
        grab_beverage.add_precondition(self.container_at(beverage, self.balcony_entrance))
        grab_beverage.add_effect(self.container_at(beverage, self.balcony_entrance), False)
        grab_beverage.add_effect(self.robot_has(beverage), True)
        grab_beverage.add_effect(self.load_balanced, False)

        grab_tray = InstantaneousAction("grab_tray")
        grab_tray.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.tray_storage))
        grab_tray.add_precondition(self.container_at(self.tray, self.tray_storage))
        grab_tray.add_effect(self.container_at(self.tray, self.tray_storage), False)
        grab_tray.add_effect(self.using_tray, True)
        grab_tray.add_effect(self.load_balanced, True)

        place_beverage = InstantaneousAction("place_beverage", beverage=self.ContainerType)
        beverage = place_beverage.parameter("beverage")
        place_beverage.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.guest_area))
        place_beverage.add_precondition(self.robot_has(beverage))
        place_beverage.add_effect(self.container_at(beverage, self.guest_area), True)
        place_beverage.add_effect(self.robot_has(beverage), False)

        return navigate_to_entrance, navigate_to_guest_area, navigate_to_tray_storage, grab_beverage, grab_tray, place_beverage

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_guest_area": And([
                Not(self.load_balanced),
                self.balcony_has_uneven_surface,
                self.balcony_is_crowded,
                Not(self.robot_has_advanced_balancing)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.balcony_entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.container_at(self.beverage1, self.balcony_entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.container_at(self.beverage2, self.balcony_entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.container_at(self.tray, self.tray_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balcony_has_uneven_surface, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balcony_is_crowded, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_advanced_balancing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.load_balanced, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.using_tray, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.container_at(self.beverage1, self.guest_area))
        problem.add_goal(self.container_at(self.beverage2, self.guest_area))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
